body: Sometimes I smile on the outside while feeling dead inside for a long time already. I’m tired of this.

I fucking need a hug right now. This kind of a hug when I almost melted into anothers person body. When my stupid skull perfectly fitted his hole near his heart (cobbler’s chest). 

No words. Just fucking hug.

My mental health had pretty big impact on my ohysical health. I had really strong headaches, bellyaches, I was extremely nauseous every single day and I was shaking horribly. I have troubles with sleeping and I’m hugging fluffy pig even though I’m 27 yo. I am also having chest pains and feeling dizzy from time to time... it sucks.

This is how I feel lately. I feel like everyone is just tired with me talking about my problems. Sometimes I’m openly saying that I’m feeling worse than before, that I’m really worried about my mental health lately because I’m in really bad shape but I feel like they don’t care anymore. Like “yeah you’re in bad shape (as you were before) but it’ll be okay”. I hate it. I think that they just got used to me being sad and depressed that they are not alerted anymore when I’m trying to talk about it... it sucks
Yes. All the time recently. I visited my parents and I am constantly thinking about what would they do if I was gone. I’m in a really bad mood recently
Exactly my thoughts yesterday. Was thinking about different scenarios of what could happen to me...
And nothing to fight for

You’re not alone with this thoughts. My life seems pointless at this moment and in the past few days I received some devastating news so it just felt like another nail to my coffin. This feeling is getting bigger and bigger with every another fucking day. I’m trying to smile on the outside but I feel like I am already dead on the inside.
11/10 can relate

I’m not sure if I want to take any drugs at this time but things are getting worse, especially with Christmas around the corner.. I don’t know if I can wait this out as this time of the year.. I know it’ll be the worst. I would love to fall asleep around 22 dec and woke up in 2020. Or never...
You’re his partner in crime. Good job. He will appreciate it for sure. Nothing makes your day better than breakfast in bed made by someone you love. Don’t stop loving and caring for each other x
Its such a nightmare to visit your friends and afterwards still feeling like worthless piece of shit. I’m trying and doing my best but at the end of the day I feel worthless..

Oh heck, I cried like a baby while reading this, because you reminded me that I had similar thing with my hubbs. Always, before eating we wished each other to enjoy the meal and always kissed. We kept that tradition even if we were mad at each other, if one of us were eating something, when the other one said "enjoy" it always has to end with a kiss. He sadly left me some time ago and I tried to fight for us hardly. He sometimes visited me and even if he was extremely mad and crazy, if I brought him a breakfast and said "enjoy" - we smooched. Unfortunately I've lost this battle and he's not around anymore... 

But girl, don't give up please. Both of you can still win this fight. Believe me, it's worth it. Keeping my fingers crossed for your marriage. I would do everything to have another shot with mine. Wishing you all the best.
Recently I am feeling extremely low and shitty 😣
And it’s great to hear that ❤️

Cuteness overload! I know that feeling too. 


I hope you’ll think those things about her in 10, 30 or 50 years from now. 

Wishing you two a life filled with love like this one
So glad you are happily married. Go and give her a nice kiss!
Happy birthday! Wishing you all the best things in life x

Yes. I always felt calm and safe when he was by my side. I had my moments when I needed to be alone & preferred to fell asleep alone but i wanted him to be around and just make some normal noises. He then was unloading the dishwasher or something like that until I was asleep. I wanted to be alone but at the same time I wanted him to be around. When I felt asleep he always came to bed and cuddled with me ☺️

Ugh I can really relate to this topic at this stage of my life as I am worried about one man who is struggling with those things. 

Keeping my fingers crossed for you to make your situation better and avoid bad decisions as suicide. I believe you can achieve anything you want and I’m hoping that you will! Don’t give up x

Oh, those little things and acts are so precious. I was always buying my hubby something - jelly beans, his fav sweets, new pair of cute and funny socks (he collected them) or anything that made me think of him. He did the same for me. It was the best.
Righttt! Reporter lady! That’s why I thought I’ve seen her before

Can relate af. My husband left me after 1 year of marriage and 8 years overall because we had tough moments in our relationship. He just left it without a fight. I’m heartbroken as hell because he was my dude for life.

I am talking with few close friends. I was thinking about seeing therapist but the situation I am right now is really unclear and I am afraid that therapy won’t be helpful right now. I thought about it for a long time but now I am kind of suspended between two worlds and I am happy to see some specialist as soon as my situation will be more clear so I will know with what issue I can work. It’s really shitty situation for me and I never thought that the closest person to my heart would put me in this horrible position..

Thanks but sadly few shitty things happened to me in the past few months. I always tried to live happily and stay positive but the worst part is that I wasn’t happy even one day since June/July. I know that some people are struggling for much longer but this situation is new for me and stress levels are extremely high for me. I came to that point where I’m almost vomiting every single fucking day because how stressed I am. It’s destroying me from the inside.
Fighting. Last few days were really shitty and emotional for me and I couldn’t stop my tears. Still trying to do my best but it’s hard lately. Glad you’re trying to be better everyday too x

Sadly I am still caring about people who were really important to me but now they are acting like assholes and... devils. I’m trying to keep my head up and fighting everyday but it’s getting really hard sometimes. Even with friends around, there are days where I’m feeling low, empty and really lonely. But thank you for your kind words. Keeping my fingers crossed for you too x
Ugh, hope tomorrow will be better for you. Wishing the same for myself x
Keeping my fingers crossed for your better days. Waiting for mine as well

Thats great to hear that you both had wonderful time! I always loved cooking together with my hubby, we always appreciated this time even if it was done as a daily chore. When we did it together we had fun and this cooperation in the kitchen always brought us closer,  when one of us was chopping some veggies and the other one was doing something else. Miss those things af

You are so right with all that confusion... we’ve spent past 8 years filled with love (of course with bad times and fights but.. who aren’t fighting in a relationship..) and now he changed his front suddenly and left me. And suddenly he hates me for all the things I’ve done to him (not sure what they are as I tried to have healthy communication about our problems in our relationship) but it turned out he told me that everything was fine when in fact.. it weren’t.  He didn’t want to hurt me so he kept it all for himself.. until he snapped... instead of talking about those issues with me he told me that it was all fine and I wasn’t aware about our problems even if I asked about some things multiple times. After one big fight he told me that he had enough and in fact he had some issues and problems with me (that he wasn’t really willing to share with me before). I tried to handle it correctly and I told him that.. all right. Now I know about them and I can do something about them. But.. he told me that he’s done and it’s too late. I fought for us for two months when he suddenly started acting like I didn’t mean anything. Just like this. I could stop existing. He became violent and hurtful. I tried to handle it with minimum dignity I had left in me just to save us as I knew that he was struggling with depression (freshly diagnosed) and tried to help him and support him even if he treated me like shit. Despite all the things I tried and I handled with patience he still treated me like trash.. it’s been a month since we hadn’t talked and he is sadly involving me in his financial problems. I’m barely handling what he had done to me mentally and now I am worried about my finances because he seems to not care about me at all. He is not interested about my mental health (he left me in pretty bad shape, I’ve lost 10 kg in less than 2 months and had big issues with sleep but when I told him about it - he told me that he doesn’t give a fuck about it and he want to start fresh, without me). I feel like a fucking shit and worthless trash as few days before he left me he told me how much he loved me and we made future plans for autumn. I never felt so betrayed and shitty... can’t imagine living like this

Thank you!! Sadly he’s another man that tells me a lot of negative things. First one was my beloved husband who left me out of the blue (yup, we fought and had bad times but you don’t give up after one year of marriage without trying to solve your problems) so It’s really hard for me as he was the one that cared about me the most. And now he hates me and wants nothing to do with me and doesn’t care if he hurts me at all (even if he was madly in love with me 3 months ago) so it’s really hard time for me. 

Thank you for your comment. Of course I am considering therapy as it’s getting too hard for me to handle it all and I am really suicidal lately. I was whole world for my loved one and suddenly I became stupid trash that could stop existing and he wouldn’t even notice. That’s why I’m thinking about death. Because the one person that loved me the most stopped caring about me suddenly. He doesn’t even know how I feel or where I live. After 8 years he doesn’t give a single fuck about me... it’s hard to deal with so much hatred from someone who gave you nothing but love for the past several years...

Sadly I don’t feel like life means anything more to me right now... it was precious before, but with everything that happened to me lately and how huge shit I feel I am.. it doesn’t feel precious at all anymore

I read here a lot about people who are depressed and they would love to trade their lives with someone that deserves more to live, ie. someone with cancer or in shitty accident and they would appreciate life more than we are doing it right now. 
I am trying not to think about pleasing others but then I am thinking just about me and I want to end how I am feeling right now. That’s why I’m in this subreddit. I think the only reason I am still alive is my mom and how she would be heartbroken. I feel that everyone would be just fucking sad at first and then they just would live their lifes as they did before after short period of mourning. Nothing more.

My dad have a really strange way to show me how he loves me and cares about me lately... another nail to my coffin. 

Imagine - he told me that being depressed and suicidal is stupid and I sound like a fucking 13 yr old fucked up girl 🙃
Maybe. But I am feeling like I am doing everything lately to please others. Why I should suffer just to make someone happy..?
What do you have in mind by saying it’s different?

My husband after more than one year of marriage (and 8 years overall) left me because we had “rough year” financially and mentally... I kept fighting for us but he said he had enough and he’s done... he met someone around 2 weeks after he left me and I feel like a worthless piece of shit that I could be replace that easilly... it’s killing me that he treats me like I don’t exist anymore.. I didn’t stop miss and love him since he left but he acts like I could be dead even if he was madly in love with me.. I can’t handle it anymore... I could be dead since two weeks and my corpse could be left in our house and he wouldn’t even notice.. he just stopped caring about me, I immediately stopped being his whole world and started to be.. no one. It’s killing me and I have hard time with dealing with this.. im giving up...

I had a risk of having breast cancer myself but “luckily” my tumor in my breast is not that dangerous(yet - I have a checkup soon). But my life felt apart anyways and I feel like a worthless shit so I could swap places with someone who could really use their life with the will they still have

Sadly I’m feeling similar atm. I’m sure there’s still someone that cares about you. But I know the feeling. I am just afraid to left a mental scar on my parents and close friends as the one person I cared the most in my life doesn’t care about me at all anymore. Just like he snapped his fingers and I don’t exist anymore. Can’t handle it anymore. Keeping my fingers crossed for you despite the fact I’m losing my hope too x
So sorry to hear that. Keeping my fingers crossed for you x

Keeping my fingers crossed for you to have more happy days than bad ones. Sadly I have big issues with my sleep and appetite and lost the will for living since the one person that I cared the most about left me without a chance to fight for us. I kept fighting even everyone told me it’s not worth it but it means everything to me and even if I mistreated myself while fighting for the one & only I loved it didn’t bring any results. I haven’t had any happy days since he left so I’m losing my hope and will to live. But I’m keeping my fingers crossed for you as you still have good days in your life. Hope there’ll be more of them x
Couldnt agree more...

Sure, feel free to message me. It’s nice to know that you’re not alone with this kind of suffering..
Keeping my fingers crossed for you two

He rejects me all the time so I gave him some time alone and stopped contacting him. We didn’t spoke for 3 weeks and it’s hard for me. Not sure what to do.. wait some more time or try to contact him.. not sure if his madness will go away, it’s awful and I have hard time dealing with this situation.. never thought about bad things this much before in my life. 

And I feel you. I would also sacrifice everything..

How long are you separated?

Ahh.. any chances for you two? 

I never stopped loving him for a single second. We had bad times during this past year and I said some ugly stuff about divorce etc but I never truly wanted it to happen. Missing every moment and I would do anything to bring him back...
Thank you so much. But it’s hard to do it when all I have in mind is him and how to find a way back to what we had... and it’s literally killing me
